status: PROPOSED exception record; source geometry only, not routed or measured
rule: An added S2b protection diode is placed within 24 mm (CLUSTER_RADIUS_MM) of its anchor: the amplifiers on its own nets, else the one non-logic IC sharing most of its nets (scripts/checks/partition35_floorplan.py). A diode that cannot be placed inside the radius must be listed here.

exceptions.anchor: U4206 (TMUX6112PWR); no amplifier shares its nets

search_evidence.method: Instrumented copy of the generator at the committed floorplan (identical output): every 1 mm offset within 24 mm of the anchor, both faces, rotations 0 and 90

exceptions.electrical_impact: Both nets are logic-level envelope slope-select control (an HC00 gate output to an analog-switch select input), not a precision analog node. The extra 3.6 mm beyond the radius adds trace length and a little capacitance on a slow select line. This is a design assumption, not a measurement.
exceptions.proposed_resolution: Phase 36 trial (generator rule nudged_pose: one pinned bypass capacitor may move at most 2.0 mm on its own face without lengthening its supply loop): rejected. Only C4270 (U4245) and C4249 (U4232) are sole blockers of in-radius poses. With either released, the nearest legal pose for C4270 is 20.43 mm away, which lengthens its supply-pad gap from 2.52 mm to 18.11 mm, and C4249 has no legal pose at all. No minimal move exists, so the exception stands.
exceptions.decision: user decision (keep the exception, or allow a multi-part re-placement)
